author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Go to https://surfshark.com/drinker and use code drinker at checkout to get 4 extra months of Surfshark!

Ten years ago, the average wait time between TV seasons was 11 months. Now it's at least twice that, sometimes three entire years. What is going on, why is it happening, and what effect is it having on audiences? Let's find out.
title: Why Modern TV Sucks - THREE YEARS Between Seasons!?
